name: utm_*
description: Google Analytics and open standard campaign parameters, used to track source, medium, campaign, content, term, and identifiers.

name: fbclid
description: Facebook Click ID, used by Facebook to track user clicks and link them to advertising campaigns.

name: gclid
description: Google Click ID, used by Google AdWords to track clicks and attribute conversions.

name: gclsrc
description: Google Click Source parameter, specifying the AdWords platform source for conversion tracking.

name: gbraid
description: Google Ads Click ID for web-to-app conversions on iOS under App Tracking Transparency.

name: wbraid
description: Google Ads Click ID for app-to-web conversions on iOS under App Tracking Transparency.

name: dclid
description: DoubleClick Click ID, used to track display advertisements.

name: srsltid
description: Google Merchant and Shopping result Click ID, appended to search and shopping result links.

name: msclkid
description: Microsoft Click ID, used by Bing Ads to track clicks and attribute conversions.

name: yclid
description: Yandex Click ID, used by Yandex Direct to track clicks and attribute conversions.

name: twclid
description: X (Twitter) Click ID, used by X Ads to track clicks and attribute conversions.

name: ttclid
description: TikTok Click ID, used by TikTok Ads to track clicks and attribute conversions.

name: li_fat_id
description: LinkedIn Ads first-party ad tracking Click ID.

name: sc_cid
description: Snapchat Click ID, used by Snapchat Ads to track clicks and attribute conversions.

name: si
description: Spotify and YouTube Share ID, containing analytical telemetry to identify the sharing source profile. Scoped to those domains since "si" is a generic query key elsewhere.

name: igsh
description: Instagram Share ID, containing analytical telemetry to identify the sharing source profile.

name: rcm
description: LinkedIn member referral tracking parameter.

name: _hsenc
description: HubSpot email tracking parameter, used to identify the recipient of a marketing email.

name: _hsmi
description: HubSpot email tracking parameter, used to identify the specific marketing email send.

name: mc_eid
description: Mailchimp Email ID, used to link an email click back to a subscriber profile.

name: mc_cid
description: Mailchimp Campaign ID, used to identify a specific email campaign.

name: pk_*
description: Matomo and Piwik campaign tracking parameters (source, medium, campaign, content, keyword).

name: mtm_*
description: Matomo Tag Manager campaign tracking parameters (source, medium, campaign, placement).

name: matomo_*
description: Matomo analytics campaign and keyword tracking parameters.

name: piwik_*
description: Legacy Piwik analytics campaign and keyword tracking parameters.

name: mkt_tok
description: Marketo email and campaign tracking token.

name: ck_subscriber_id
description: ConvertKit email subscriber tracking identifier.

name: zanpid
description: Awin and Zanox affiliate network click tracking ID.

name: irclickid
description: Impact Radius affiliate click tracking ID.

name: rb_clickid
description: Rebounce Click ID, used for redirect tracking and attribution.

name: affclick
description: Affiliate Click ID, used to track affiliate sales conversions.

name: aff_id
description: Affiliate partner identifier parameter.

name: campid
description: eBay Partner Network campaign identifier.

name: feature
description: YouTube video sharing source parameter. Scoped to YouTube's domains since "feature" is a generic query key elsewhere (e.g. feature-flag or deep-link parameters).

name: ref
description: Amazon reference and navigation tracking parameter. Scoped to Amazon's domains since "ref" is a generic query key on non-Amazon sites.

name: ref_
description: Amazon referral tracking parameter.

name: social_share
description: Amazon social share tracking parameter.

name: spm
description: AliExpress and Alibaba Super Position Model tracking parameter.

name: scm
description: AliExpress Scenario Model tracking parameter.

name: aff_trace_key
description: AliExpress affiliate tracking key.

name: pvid
description: AliExpress page view tracking identifier.

name: mkevt
description: eBay marketing event tracking parameter.

name: mkcid
description: eBay marketing channel identifier.

name: mkrid
description: eBay marketing rotation identifier.

name: toolid
description: eBay partner network tool identifier.

name: customid
description: eBay partner network custom tracking identifier.
